# Vigna Ramtej

> Vigna Ramtej Telagarapu is a Full-Stack & Backend Engineer based in Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh, India. He builds Django backends, AWS serverless systems and LLM pipelines, and is currently a Backend & Automation Engineer at CoComply AI. Open to full-time roles, freelance projects and collaborations.

## Experience

- CoComply AI — Backend & Automation Engineer (Mar 2026 – present): Django + PostgreSQL backend, Regulatory Intelligence LLM pipeline, internal GTM platform (Next.js, TypeScript, 130+ API routes) on AWS Amplify, queue + Python worker system for async LLM jobs.
- Secure Blink — Backend Developer Intern (Aug 2025 – Dec 2025): monolith to AWS Lambda migration (cold start 2.3s → 890ms, 61% lower), RBAC across 15+ API endpoints, static analysis engine for OWASP Top 10.
- Labfox.Studio — Full Stack Developer Intern (Mar 2025 – May 2025).

## Education

- B.Tech in Artificial Intelligence & Data Science, Sagi Ramakrishnam Raju Engineering College (2022–2026), CGPA 8.58.
